//===== rAthena Script =======================================
//= Crude Armorer (custom)
//===== Description: =========================================
//= Sells the Crude equipment and the Siege shields, glasses, masks and rings.
//= Menu order: Upper Headgear, Mid / Lower Headgear, Armor, Shield, Garment, Shoes, Accessories.
//= The price of each item is in the shop lines at the bottom (item id:price in zeny).
//= Generated by srh_lite/tools/items/make_crude_shop.py
//============================================================

hero_ent3,61,128,4	script	Crude Armorer	858,{
	mes "[Crude Armorer]";
	mes "Basic gear for every fighter.";
	mes "What are you looking for?";
	next;
	switch (select("Upper Headgear:Mid / Lower Headgear:Armor:Shield:Garment:Shoes:Accessories:Cancel")) {
	case 1: close2; callshop "pg_shop_headgear_top",1; end;
	case 2: close2; callshop "pg_shop_headgear_midlow",1; end;
	case 3: close2; callshop "pg_shop_armor",1; end;
	case 4: close2; callshop "pg_shop_shield",1; end;
	case 5: close2; callshop "pg_shop_garment",1; end;
	case 6: close2; callshop "pg_shop_shoes",1; end;
	case 7: close2; callshop "pg_shop_accessories",1; end;
	case 8: close;
	}
}

-	shop	pg_shop_headgear_top	-1,210025:150000,210026:150000,210027:150000,210028:150000,210029:150000,210030:150000,210031:150000,210032:150000
